title: 7 Best Cursor Alternatives in 2026: Code Editors, AI Agents, and Full-Stack Builders
summary: Cursor leads AI coding with 40M+ users, but it's an editor — not a full-stack builder. Here are the 7 best Cursor alternatives in 2026, covering code editors, terminal agents, and app builders.
body_markdown: They solve different problems. Cursor is an IDE with AI built in — great for inline autocomplete and agent help while writing code in a file tree. Claude Code is a terminal agent — built for autonomous multi-step tasks where you want Claude to read your repo, plan changes, and execute end-to-end without you driving. Developers who need fast autocomplete and visual diffs use Cursor. Developers who want to say "refactor this entire module" and walk away use Claude Code. For a full breakdown, see our[Cursor vs Claude Code comparison](https://blink.new/blog/cursor-vs-claude-code) .
